name: trickster-extentkey-v2
instr:
**Stage dashboards draw prod's numbers once they go through Trickster**

We put Trickster (influxdb backend, in-memory cache) in front of our InfluxDB 1.8 server. Grafana has an InfluxQL datasource per database, telegraf_prod and telegraf_stage, each signing in over basic auth with its own read-only InfluxDB user (the prod user can't read stage and the other way round), and both go through the same Trickster backend. Since then, open the CPU panel on prod, flip to stage, and stage draws prod's line, or the other way round. Widen the time range after a flip and the older half of the graph comes from one environment, the newer half from the other. The same queries sent straight to InfluxDB are right for both. Restarting Trickster clears it until the next flip.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, as a _test.go file (say ./repro_test.go, next to the code it tests), that fails on the current code because
of this problem (a real test failure, not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own
from a clean checkout with just your test files added.

I doubt I'm the only one hitting this. Anything else that goes through that code is probably
